title: Copilot Credit Compass rate card
disclaimer: Independent planning rate card. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or a pricing quotation from Microsoft. Rows marked verified:false are market-observed or interpolated and must be confirmed with your Microsoft account team before purchase.

changelog.summary: Initial seed rate card. Copilot Studio consumption rates from Microsoft Learn 'Billing rates and management'. Commercial rates from public Microsoft pricing pages. P3 pre-purchase tier ladder interpolated from the two published anchor points (15,000 CU tier approx. 6 percent, upper tiers trending to approx. 20 percent).

Two corrections. GitHub Copilot migrated from premium requests to AI credits, the billing model GitHub adopted on 2026-06-01: 1 AI credit = $0.01, included allowances 1,900 (Business) and 3,900 (Enterprise) per user per month pooled at the billing entity, no rollover, overage on by default, and code completions and next edit suggestions unlimited and never billed. The expired launch promotional allowance is retained flagged expired so the app can explain a dropped allowance. Separately, cowork-task was wrongly marked as zero-rated by a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence; Cowork consumes Copilot Credits against the Microsoft 365 usage-based billing limit and is not offset by holding a seat. Version bumped so benchmark submissions made before and after the correction are distinguishable.

ai-tools-basic-response.label: Text and generative AI tools - basic (per response)

ai-tools-standard-response.label: Text and generative AI tools - standard (per response)

ai-tools-premium-response.label: Text and generative AI tools - premium (per response)

ai-tools-basic-tokens.label: Text and generative AI tools - basic (per 1K tokens)

ai-tools-standard-tokens.label: Text and generative AI tools - standard (per 1K tokens)

ai-tools-premium-tokens.label: Text and generative AI tools - premium (per 1K tokens)

voice-classic-minute.label: Voice - classic orchestration
voice-classic-minute.note: Core agent activity is included in the per-minute rate. Voice traffic is modelled as never licence-offset because contact-centre callers are not Microsoft 365 Copilot licence holders.

retrieval-api-query.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot Retrieval API query (preview)
retrieval-api-query.note: Preview meter. Rate is a planning placeholder, not a published Microsoft figure.

cowork-task.label: Copilot Cowork / Work IQ API task
cowork-task.offsetNote: Not zero-rated by a Microsoft 365 Copilot seat. Cowork task execution consumes Copilot Credits against the organisation's Microsoft 365 usage-based billing limit, unlike core Copilot Studio agent activity where a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence offsets the traffic. Holding a seat does not make a Cowork task free.
cowork-task.note: Market-observed planning placeholder for usage-based Copilot Credit consumption.

github-ai-credit.label: GitHub Copilot AI credit
github-ai-credit.displayRate: 1 AI credit = $0.01, the same unit price as a pay-as-you-go Copilot Credit
github-ai-credit.offsetNote: A Microsoft 365 Copilot seat has no bearing on GitHub Copilot billing. These are separate products with separate meters.
github-ai-credit.note: GitHub AI credits and Microsoft Copilot Credits are different currencies that happen to share a $0.01 unit price, so they are carried at 1:1 to keep one credit column in the model. They are not interchangeable in reality: GitHub overage is billed by GitHub and cannot be drawn from a Microsoft capacity pack, a MACC or an Azure prepayment.

paygCreditUsd.label: Pay-as-you-go Copilot Credit
paygCreditUsd.note: Azure meter billed to an Azure subscription. Also the meter for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat agents and SharePoint agents.

capacityPack.label: Copilot Studio prepaid capacity pack
capacityPack.note: Tenant-level pool. Unused capacity does not roll over - it resets on the first of each month.

m365CopilotSeatMonthlyUsd.label: Microsoft 365 Copilot seat
m365CopilotSeatMonthlyUsd.unit: USD per user per month (annual commitment)
m365CopilotSeatMonthlyUsd.note: Add-on to a qualifying Microsoft 365 base plan.

githubCopilot.label: GitHub Copilot
githubCopilot.poolNote: Included AI credits are pooled across the billing entity rather than ring-fenced per user. Adding licences mid-cycle grows the pool immediately; removing them only shrinks it from the next cycle.

promotionalAllowance.label: Launch promotional AI credit allowance
promotionalAllowance.note: Ran from 1 June to 1 September 2026 and has now ended. Retained so the app can explain to a user who remembers the higher figure why their allowance dropped to the standard 1,900 / 3,900.

interactionArchetypes.label: Light chat question
interactionArchetypes.blurb: A short question to Copilot Chat on a small or economy model, little context attached.

interactionArchetypes.label: Standard chat with file context
interactionArchetypes.blurb: A question with a file or two attached, answered on a mid-tier model.

interactionArchetypes.label: Agent task across a few files
interactionArchetypes.blurb: Copilot CLI or the cloud agent making a scoped change, reading and writing several files.

interactionArchetypes.label: Long frontier-model agent session
interactionArchetypes.blurb: A long-running agent session on a frontier model across many files, with repeated tool calls.

githubCopilot.interactionArchetypeNote: GitHub bills AI credits by model and token volume (input, output and cached), not by a published per-interaction table. These archetypes are estimated planning placeholders derived from the shape of that billing model, not GitHub figures. Check your own usage page for real numbers.

foundry.label: Microsoft Foundry bring-your-own-model tokens
foundry.note: Representative mid-tier frontier model pricing. Replace with your negotiated Foundry or PTU rate.

p3PrePurchasePlan.label: Copilot Credit Pre-Purchase Plan (P3)
p3PrePurchasePlan.note: Purchased CCCUs pay down qualifying Copilot Credit retail cost in USD, where 1 CU is approximately $1 of retail cost. Only the 15,000 CU tier discount is published; the remaining ladder is interpolated toward the stated approx. 20 percent ceiling.

maccEligibility.label: Azure consumption commitment (MACC) burn-down eligibility
maccEligibility.note: MACC treatment varies by agreement. Always confirm eligibility with your Microsoft account team before relying on burn-down.

modelAssumptions.githubAiCreditAssumptionNote: Planning placeholders, not GitHub figures. Built from the interactionArchetypes in commercial.githubCopilot at their typical values: a standard developer at roughly 60 chats (3 credits) plus 20 scoped agent tasks (25 credits) lands near 700; a heavy developer at roughly 150 chats, 80 agent tasks and 6 long frontier-model sessions (180 credits) lands near 3,500. Code completions and next edit suggestions are excluded because they are unlimited and never billed on paid plans. Replace both figures from your own GitHub billing usage page before quoting anything.
